```typescript title="TypeScript"

async function main() {
  const client = createClient("your-api-key");
  const result = await client.chat({ messages: [{ content: "Hello", role: "user" }], model: "gpt-4" });
  console.log(result.hookOnRequestCalled);
}

void main();
```
